# Kernel source fixtures

The unmodified files under `kernel-base/` come from AOSP common commit
`7c6bbcca33e1734642601acf07a14140116fa956`. They preserve their original
notices and allow testing the exact four-patch baseline without downloading
a complete kernel checkout. See `LICENSES/GPL-2.0.txt` and the root
`THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md`.
